comments_data.body:
Hello @lebaphi - I think I'll be handing this branch over to you, soon.

I've got the `basics` for editing commodities working in the `setting-platform-types` admin page. If you click on `fishing-vessel` you'll see the `Commodities` editor section.  It's working in the storybook.  But, I've only seen how to support a single toggle button.  As the `commodities-UI` issue describes, I now realise we need more columns in the editor: https://github.com/serge-web/serge/issues/1291#issuecomment-1029230097

We've got to wait for Shend to finish the UX for these extra columns, but it would be useful if you could modify the `Commodities` sorted-table by adding a column/text-box for `Units`. I presume this is done in `renderCommoditiesSection`.

Thanks @lebaphi .   A step forward, but we still need column headers - to understand the data.
![Screenshot 2022-02-05 at 10 22 42](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/152638235-79986c1f-73fa-4000-bc86-d5d782537263.png)
Hi @IanMayo @ShendMikullovci , I just added the header, how do you think?

> Hi @IanMayo @ShendMikullovci , I just added the header, how do you think? > > Are you able to use a row of icons, like @ShendMikullovci design [here](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/issues/1291#issuecomment-1030903575)?

Great progress @lebaphi 

1. We need a column for default value
2. We don't need both "bin" and "cross" buttons. _Think_ I prefer the `x` on the right-hand side
3. The row becomes unstable if the name of the new commodity gets deleted.  It goes to `undefined` and can't be edited.  I guess we need to prevent the whole name being deleted
4. @ShendMikullovci has come up with a set of icons for the columns.  If you create tooltips for them - I can fill in the tooltip text.
5. The columns for `units` and `format` can be restricted to 5 chars.  That will allow more room for the wider fields (name and description).

> 2. We don't need both "bin" and "cross" buttons. _Think_ I prefer the `x` on the right-hand side

I do too. It's much neater, though I've kept using the bin for icon uniformity. 

Do we need a description of the commodities?

> Do we need a description of the commodities?

"Need" is a bit strong. No, we don't _need_ the description. Let me check with game-designer.
